name: The nap at a night's lock sleeps at once, until you unlock
case: At night, the person locks the Mac with an agent's thread sitting idle. Boop says good night with a real wave and a sign, and takes its nap: asleep at once, as Doing says, not after the usual doze. A short unlock wakes it, with a slight wave.
why: MomentRule.bye: a lock at night with no agent working is good night and the nap. Core.nap holds the sleep, so no Jev is needed
